records.aiNotes: Actual independent native1672x941,316x178,360x203,680x383 with448heightcap inspection. HOLD. The large formula is correctly CH3-C(=O)-O-CH2-CH3, C4H8O2. Every carbon has valence four and each oxygen valence two. Orange acyl CH3, blue OCH2, green terminal CH3 match singlet 3H~2.1ppm, quartet 2H~4.1ppm and triplet 3H~1.3ppm. The IR motif correctly marks carbonyl absorption near1740cm^-1 without a contradictory calibrated wavenumber axis. Separate NMR cards prevent false shared coordinate interpretation. However, the blue four-line pattern has inner lines about twice the outer line height (visually ~1:2:2:1), rather than the first-order ethyl quartet ~1:3:3:1. The green triplet is drawn~1:2:1. This is a concrete wrong spectral representation, not an uncertainty in the valid proton assignment. At316/360 the molecule, three H counts and shifts, signal multiplicities and red C=O motif remain recognizable; schematisch is very small at316 but not the reason for HOLD. At680 the incorrect blue intensity proportion remains visible. records.aiNotes: Actual independent native1672x941,316x178,360x203,680x383 with448heightcap inspection. PASS. Aldehyde R-C(=O)-H and ketone R-C(=O)-R-prime fragments each give carbonyl-carbon valence four. Large sample tubes distinguish a blue blank, brick-red Cu2O in the aldehyde example, and blue ordinary ketone. Cu2+ notation and Cu2O formula are correct. The select-observe-interpret sequence fits qualitative identification and the complete current goal; the pair of carbonyl examples does not claim that no other functional classes exist. Smaller fragment text is compact at316 but carbonyl shapes and aldehyde-versus-ketone fragments can still be distinguished. At680 the group formulas, goggles and tube identities are clear. records.aiNotes: Actual independent native1672x941,316x178,360x203,680x383 with448heightcap inspection. HOLD. The dispersion panel shows opposing temporary partial charges at the purple attraction; dipole-dipole correctly places Cl(delta minus) against H(delta plus) in HCl; the water hydrogen bond is O-H...O with twoH per water. The ion-dipole contacts end at O(delta minus) around Na plus, and lower waters have a clear bent geometry pointing hydrogen ends away. However the upper hydrated water is drawn almost H-O-H straight across: its twoH centers are only slightly above the O center. This differs visibly from the bent lower-water motif and makes that molecule nearly linear, with no perspective cue. It undermines the depicted water dipole orientation despite correct charge labels. At316/360 the four headings and main contact types remain discernible. Superscript delta signs are small at316 but color and endpoint structure remain visible. The upper ion-dipole water reads as H-O-H in a straight row at both phone sizes; at680 the flattened geometry remains plain.
